Their finite functional-graph classification methods are mathematically exhaustive and the independent witness checker verifies (p_C,p_H)=(1,5) on each graph.

value.rationale: The three-color pointwise period-divisibility theorem has a natural but invalid four-color extrapolation. On each of two canonical 10-vertex cubic graphs a positive fraction (approximately a quarter) of all matched inputs violates divisibility, with explicit CCA-consensus/GHM-five-cycle examples. The exact joint tables establish a structurally meaningful model comparison unavailable from previously known marginal distributions, and provide benchmark finite classifications.
